FAC-001.slaRisk: CRITICAL: Contractual liquidated damages trigger at Day 12 ($1.5M per aircraft daily penalty) on the B777/B767 widebody line.
FAC-001.evidenceBase: Everett structural logs indicate a tight 4-day buffer on titanium structural spars before a widebody line shutdown.

options.label: Air Charter Expedite
options.desc: Bypass standard freight rails; charter 3x Antonov An-124 flights to Paine Field.

options.label: Fast-Track DOT Permits
options.desc: Engage Washington DOT for expedited heavy-haul corridor permissions.

options.label: Double Shift Assembly Bays
options.desc: Authorize overtime shifts in the structural integration section.

respond.objective: Contain the widebody spar shortfall and hold Everett line cadence.

actions.action: Release reserve titanium structural spars from the Wichita depot (currently 84% capacity) to the Everett widebody line and confirm buffer extension.
Issue a stop-risk advisory to the Everett widebody value stream and brief CFO/COO on the $14.5M/day exposure and Day-12 liquidated-damages trigger.

recover.objective: Restore the inbound spar pipeline via premium logistics and pre-approved alternate machining.

actions.action: Charter 3x Antonov An-124 heavy-lift flights to move composite wing skins and titanium spars directly to Paine Field (PAE), bypassing congested ocean lanes.
actions.kpi: TTR cut >= 4 days; PAE runway slots confirmed

actions.action: Shift structural spar machining to the Portland secondary facility (active on ASL) and open FAI dossier FAI-EVT-777-COMP — no Type-Certificate deviation.
actions.kpi: Portland FAI cleared; ASL compliance verified

thrive.objective: Lock in a permanent widebody spar resiliency gain.

actions.action: Re-baseline widebody spar safety-stock targets and codify a dual-source policy (primary + Portland) in the SAP material master.

SUP-001A.slaRisk: HIGH: Renton assembly line halts on Day 10. Direct delivery delay penalties of $850K per day active.
SUP-001A.evidenceBase: Midwest rail union negotiations are locked; the cooling-off period expires in 72 hours with no resolution in sight.

options.label: Over-the-road Flatbeds
options.desc: Initiate oversized flatbed road transport with police escorts.

options.label: KDOT Fast-Track Permits
options.desc: Pre-file permits in Kansas, Missouri, Illinois, and Washington.

options.label: Pre-Stage at Renton Depot
options.desc: Lease temporary logistics space near Renton receiving bays.

respond.objective: Confirm the rail exposure and protect the Renton fuselage buffer.

actions.action: Open a 4-hour RFC to Spirit AeroSystems (Wichita) global sourcing to confirm heavy-flatbed loading availability and fuselage shell readiness.
Validate the Renton fuselage shell buffer (8-day survival window) and prioritize sequencing of in-transit shells already past the strike zone.

recover.objective: Move fuselage shells by road and stand up a contingency sub-assembly source.

actions.action: Mobilize 6 oversized heavy-haul road convoys (Wichita to Renton) with police escorts, bypassing the struck rail yards entirely.
actions.kpi: TTR cut >= 6 days; shells delivered on split schedule

actions.action: Engage Spirit's Tulsa facility to pre-kit secondary fuselage sub-assemblies as a contingency, queuing FAI where work transfers between sites.
actions.trigger: Primary Wichita output slips past Day 8
actions.kpi: Tulsa contingency line validated; FAI cleared

thrive.objective: Make Renton fuselage flow resilient to single-mode rail risk.

actions.action: Establish a Renton-proximate fuselage buffer depot and codify a multimodal rail/road contingency routing policy in the ERP.
actions.kpi: Buffer depot live; multimodal routing policy approved

SUP-701X.slaRisk: SEVERE: GEnx engine shortfall threatens 787 Charleston deliveries; ~$2.1M/day deferred-revenue and engine-swap penalties accrue from Day 8.
SUP-701X.evidenceBase: Howmet single-crystal HPT blade castings scrapped after a vacuum-furnace fault; GEnx hot-section build paused with ~3-week casting recovery.

options.label: Backup Casting Furnace (Howmet)
options.desc: Transfer HPT blade molds to Howmet backup furnace #5 and replace vacuum flange seals.

options.label: GEnx Engine Buffer Release
options.desc: Release pooled spare GEnx engines from the Charleston flight-line buffer.

options.label: Engine Airlift to Charleston
options.desc: Charter heavy freight to move finished engines from Ohio to Charleston.

respond.objective: Protect 787 final assembly from the GEnx hot-section pause.

actions.action: Release pooled spare GEnx engines from the Charleston flight-line buffer to protect 787 final assembly cadence.
Issue an RFC to the GE Aerospace program desk for a revised HPT blade casting recovery date and a GEnx engine delivery re-plan.

recover.objective: Recover blade castings via a pre-qualified furnace and compress engine transit.

actions.action: Transfer single-crystal HPT blade molds to the pre-qualified Howmet backup furnace #5 and queue FAI for the alternate casting cell — no recipe deviation.
actions.kpi: Howmet castings pass CT/NDT; FAI cleared

actions.action: Airlift finished GEnx engines from the Ohio plant to Charleston via dedicated heavy freight to compress transit time.

thrive.objective: Harden engine hot-section supply against single-furnace risk.

actions.action: Raise GEnx engine and HPT blade safety-stock targets and formalize a dual-furnace casting policy (PCC + Howmet) in the ERP.
actions.kpi: Dual-furnace policy live; engine buffer target +20%

SUP-302B.slaRisk: ELEVATED: Titanium structural forging lead-times stretching; 737/787 spar and landing-gear builds at risk if sponge imports stay delayed past Day 20.
SUP-302B.evidenceBase: Titanium sponge import held at customs; PCC forging feedstock coverage ~18 days; VSMPO and domestic alternates hold qualified spot capacity.

options.label: Qualified Alternate Allocation
options.desc: Activate pre-qualified VSMPO / domestic sponge allocation under ASL.

options.label: Customs Fast-Track
options.desc: Expedite import clearance via licensed broker and bonded warehouse.

respond.objective: Ring-fence titanium feedstock for flight-critical forgings.

actions.action: Confirm PCC titanium sponge and forging feedstock coverage (~18 days) and ring-fence allocation for flight-critical spar and landing-gear forgings.
Notify procurement and the impacted 737/787 value streams of the forging lead-time risk and request demand re-prioritization.

recover.objective: Open an alternate sponge source and clear the held shipment.

actions.action: Activate the pre-qualified VSMPO / domestic sponge allocation under ASL and queue FAI for any new forging source.
Expedite customs clearance via a licensed broker and bonded warehouse to release the held sponge shipments.

thrive.objective: Reduce structural exposure to single-origin titanium.

actions.action: Increase the titanium sponge strategic buffer and codify a dual-origin sourcing policy (domestic + allied) in the ERP.
actions.kpi: Dual-origin policy live; sponge buffer +30 days

SUP-883T.slaRisk: ELEVATED: Export controls on nickel superalloy precursors threaten engine hot-section parts; lead-time slip risks GEnx/LEAP build schedules beyond Day 25.
SUP-883T.evidenceBase: Export-license restriction on nickel/cobalt precursors; ATI melt-shop coverage ~22 days; Carpenter Technology holds qualified alternate heat lots.

options.label: Carpenter Alternate Heats
options.desc: Pull qualified superalloy heat lots from Carpenter Technology under ASL.

options.label: Export-License Expedite
options.desc: Engage trade-compliance counsel to expedite end-use licensing.

respond.objective: Secure superalloy billet for flight-critical engine forgings.

actions.action: Ring-fence ATI nickel superalloy billet coverage (~22 days) for flight-critical turbine and disk forgings.
Brief procurement, trade compliance, and the engine programs on the export-restriction exposure and convene a risk review.

recover.objective: Qualify an alternate melt source and clear restricted precursors.

actions.action: Activate qualified Carpenter Technology heat lots under ASL and queue FAI for the alternate melt source — no chemistry deviation.
Expedite end-use export licensing via trade-compliance counsel to release the restricted precursor shipments.

thrive.objective: Build a durable superalloy reserve and dual-melt policy.

actions.action: Establish a strategic superalloy reserve and a dual-melt-source policy (ATI + Carpenter), registered in the ERP.
actions.kpi: Dual-melt policy live; superalloy reserve +30 days

SUP-447H.slaRisk: HIGH: Air-cargo capacity crunch is delaying FADEC / engine-controller deliveries; engine dress-up build is at risk from Day 12.
SUP-447H.evidenceBase: Honeywell FADEC modules stranded by a belly-cargo capacity shortage; ~10-day line coverage; Collins holds a form-fit-function alternate under ASL.

options.label: Dedicated Air Charter
options.desc: Book dedicated freighter capacity for FADEC modules, bypassing the belly-cargo shortage.

options.label: Collins Alternate Module
options.desc: Activate the Collins form-fit-function alternate controller under ASL.

respond.objective: Protect the engine dress-up sequence from the controller shortfall.

actions.action: Confirm the FADEC / engine-controller buffer (~10 days) and prioritize modules for the near-term engine dress-up sequence.
Issue an RFC to Honeywell logistics for committed freighter slots and a revised controller delivery ETA.

recover.objective: Secure dedicated freight and qualify an alternate controller.

actions.action: Book dedicated freighter capacity for FADEC modules to bypass the belly-cargo shortage.
Activate the Collins form-fit-function controller alternate under ASL and queue FAI / airworthiness sign-off.

thrive.objective: Make propulsion-electronics supply dual-sourced and freight-resilient.

actions.action: Raise controller safety stock and codify a dual-source policy (Honeywell + Collins) plus pre-booked freight lanes in the ERP.
actions.kpi: Dual-source policy live; controller buffer +15 days
